notes:
Summary: Storied Searchworks manages ~14M archived media assets (text transcripts, long-form articles, OCRed image text). Primary need: fast, accurate enterprise search + RAG for editorial teams and legal discovery. They are very price-sensitive at scale and need predictable latency for interactive tools.

Data & scale: average document length ~12k words; 95th percentile up to 120k words (OCR-heavy). Prefer to avoid indexing raw long-docs as single vectors. Expect ~60M chunks after current planned chunking strategy; growth ~25%/yr.

Tech priorities discussed:
- Two-stage retrieval: cheap ANN pass (512-d) -> lightweight scorer -> transformer-based reranker for top-K (K=20)
- Chunking: prefer variable-length semantic chunks (200-800 tokens) with 20-30% overlap for passage continuity. Want metadata-preserving chunk ids and original offsets for reunification at display time.
- Reranker tuning: tune on editorial judgments; heavy emphasis on precision@5 and MRR. Discussed training pairwise reranker on company-specific labeled pairs vs using open-source monoBERT/rerank models.
- Embeddings model: evaluation of open LLaMA-derived embedding vs higher-cost proprietary; tradeoffs on cosine retrieval recall vs tokenization drift on OCR text.
- Latency targets: cold retrieval+rerank median <= 400ms for internal tools, p95 <= 1.2s. Cost target: <$0.015/query overall (including ANN cost + reranker compute).
- Caching: prefix caching for repeated editorial queries; KV caching for reranker contexts explored.

Operational concerns / security:
- Must run in customer VPC or on-prem with customer-managed KMS. Legal requires data residency guarantees (US-only) and retention controls for PII redaction. SOC2+ISO27001 expected for go-live.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown and per-query trace required for billing shows.

CRM notes / quotes:
- "We need search to feel instant for editors — no more than half a second usually," — Head of Product.
- SE suggested a small dedicated cluster (4xA10G equiv) for reranker stage to hit p95 SLA; still need sizing confirmation.
- POC scope: index 2 months of editorial backlog (~1.8M docs), run A/B of static chunking vs semantic chunking, measure precision@5 and end-to-end latency.

Open items: detailed GPU footprint for on-prem package, final embedding model selection, legal redline on residency clause, target ARR band approval.

Next actionable: deliver POC cost estimate, spin up dedicated perf cluster for 2-week run, share sample reranker tuning recipes and eval harness (Aisha to provide eval set).
